The date and location come from Lim (2000) and Dzurek (1996), both PDFs; the checked first source (Hansard, 11 November 1988) describes the prosecution and warning but not the date; Hansard of 29 November 1988 places the detention in the Spratlys. Manila protested and the case strained relations through late 1988.
